messages:
Nora (Design): quick question: should we surface an inline export action in the request drilldown for single-span exports, or keep export in the top toolbar? leaning inline for discoverability.
Ben (Frontend): inline makes sense. concern: adding actions to every span could bloat the DOM. recommend lazy-mounting and reusing a single portal for the modal.
Carla (Product): support feedback: people copy full stacktraces into tickets. two export flavors would help: 'Full span JSON' and 'Minimal trace (ids + meta)'. also want an obvious 'Copy correlation ID' next to the stacktrace.
Jin (Eng Runtime): security note: exports can leak sensitive request payloads. we need server-side redaction rules and an org-level opt-in for full exports. also rate-limit exports per trace.
Rhea (A11y): accessibility: the inline menu should be a real menu button (aria-haspopup="menu"). modal needs role="dialog" and aria-modal="true". ensure focus returns to trigger on close.
Omar (Support): add helper text near the correlation id: 'Use this ID when filing a ticket or searching logs.' non-dev users find this helpful.
Ben (Frontend): keyboard details: open menu with Enter/Space, navigate with Arrow keys, activate with Enter. suggest an opt-in shortcut Shift+C to copy correlation id when a trace is focused.
Rhea (A11y): do not add shortcuts that conflict with browser defaults. announce copy/export success with aria-live="polite". ensure contrast for helper text.
Jin (Eng Runtime): proposed export formats: full-json, minimal-json, curl (presigned). presigned URLs should expire quickly. large full-json exports will be background jobs, return presigned URL when ready.
Nora (Design): UI copy: button text should be explicit: 'Copy correlation ID'. menu items: 'Export span (JSON)', 'Export minimal trace', 'Open in logs'.
Carla (Product): analytics: track ui.export.clicked with format, user_role, redaction_applied. for copy: ui.copy.correlation_id. minimal PII in events.
Ben (Frontend): CSS prototype: .span-actions { display:inline-flex; gap:8px; align-items:center; } .export-menu { min-width:180px; }
OpsBot: ticket created INFR-4282 "Inline trace export & redaction controls" assigned to @Jin.
Rhea (A11y): nit: ensure small helper text >= 4.5:1 contrast if < 14px, otherwise bump size.
Jin (Eng Runtime): perf: synchronous minimal exports only. full exports deferred to background job. add server flag allow_full_export on org settings.
Omar (Support): request: include toggle 'Include surrounding 2 requests' in minimal export for context.
Nora (Design): good call, we'll put that toggle in the modal advanced options.
Carla (Product): action items please.
Nora (Design): Action items:
- Ben: prototype keyboard-accessible inline export menu (lazy mount + portal) with copy correlation id. demo by Fri.
- Jin: design server redaction flow, rate limits, background-export job and presign TTLs.
- Rhea: produce an a11y checklist for menu and modal (roles, focus, aria-live, contrast).
- Omar: draft support blurb explaining minimal vs full export and when to use each.
- Carla: define analytics event spec and privacy guardrails.
Nora (Design): tagging: @Ben @Jin @Rhea @Omar @Carla
Ben (Frontend): will open feature/inline-export and post demo link in thread.
Jin (Eng Runtime): will sketch infra constraints and endpoint plan by EOD.
Rhea (A11y): happy to review the demo.
Omar (Support): will draft the blurb and include sample payloads.
Carla (Product): thanks team  this should make investigation flows smoother.
OpsBot: deploy queued backend/redaction v1 -> staging 2024-06-18 09:00 UTC
Nora (Design): closing loop after demo and infra check. :sparkles:
